$comment: MCP servers for this repo. Claude Code loads this automatically.
explorium-docs is the Mintlify-hosted documentation MCP (search_explorium_docs,
explorium-agentsource is the separate B2B *data* API MCP (enrich-business,
These are two different servers on two different hosts -- do not merge them.
BOTH authorize with OAuth: in a local Claude Code session run /mcp, pick the
server, choose Authenticate, and log in in the browser. Do not add an
Authorization header here -- it disables the OAuth flow. API keys are only
for the REST scripts and live in crm/config.py (from env), never in this file.
Remote Claude Code sessions cannot complete OAuth; for those, add the same
URL as a custom connector in claude.ai (Settings -> Connectors).
